middle.name: Monkey Bank
middle.description: All money generated by this farm is now stored in the bank and earns 15% interest each round. Wiki: Instead of producing collectable bananas, Banana Farm generates cash in its internal balance on each round, which is not directly added to the player's cash pool but can be withdrawn at any time. At the end of each round, it increases its balance by 15% in interest. It has a maximum balance of $7,000 ($9,500 with [img:Bigger Banks] Bigger Banks), and when it is full, it ceases to produce cash until its balance is withdrawn. If crosspathed with EZ Collect, the dollar sign glows when full, which reminds the player to collect its cash. If crosspathed with Banana Salvage, the Bank autocollects itself at the end of the round when full.

middle.name: IMF Loan
middle.description: IMF Loan ability: Gives you $9,000 but you have to pay it back over time. Wiki: This upgrade increases its bank capacity from $7,000 to $10,000 ($12,500 with [img:Bigger Banks] Bigger Banks), and grants the IMF Loan Activated Ability. This ability grants the player $9,000 ($10,000 with [img:Backroom Deals] Backroom Deals), and an equal amount of debt. The ability has an 85-second cooldown, has a full initial cooldown, has a limit of 2 uses per round, is disabled if the round lasts longer than 3 minutes, and cannot be used between rounds. Additionally, it cannot be activated while the corresponding IMF Loan has outstanding debt. The amount of money granted by the ability cannot be increased from any source except Monkey City. With [img:Bank Deposits] Bank Deposits, cash may be deposited into the IMF Loan to gain interest on it. Deposited cash only begins to accrue interest after being in the IMF Loan for 2 rounds, unlike normally generated cash which accrues interest after 1 round.

middle.name: Monkey-Nomics
middle.description: For when you're too big to fail... Wiki: This upgrade replaces the IMF Loan ability with a new ability that grants $9,000 ($10,000 with [img:Backroom Deals] Backroom Deals) debt-free. The ability has a 60-second cooldown, has a full initial cooldown, has a limit of 2 uses per round, is disabled if the round lasts longer than 3 minutes, and cannot be used between rounds. The amount of money granted by the ability can be increased via the Monkey City buff, but not any other external buff.

bottom.name: Marketplace
bottom.description: Generates money each round and adds it to your total. No fuss. Wiki: This upgrade makes the Banana Farm automatically generates 16 packets of $20 per round[fn 1], instead of generating collectibles. The total income per round is $320 if all are generated. Crosspathing with Path 1 (Increased Production and Greater Production) adds +2 packets each. Long Life Bananas does nothing, but Valuable Bananas increases value of each packet from $20 to $25 or $26 with [img:More Valuable Bananas] More Valuable Bananas. Marketplaces generate 1 life at the end of each round with [img:Healthy Bananas] Healthy Bananas.

bottom.name: Central Market
bottom.description: Earns heaps of money each round and gives Merchantmen +10% income. Wiki: This upgrade increases the amount of cash generated by Marketplace from $20 per collection to $70, for a total of +$1,120 per round before crosspathing. Increased Production and Greater Production each increase the number of collections per round by 2. Long Life Bananas does nothing to Central Market, but Valuable Bananas increases the value of each collection by +25% (+30% with [img:More Valuable Bananas] More Valuable Bananas). Also, each Central Market provides all Merchantmen and subsequent upgrades +10% increased income. This buff to merchantmen stacks additively with multiple Central Markets, and has a maximum benefit of +100%. Central Markets generate 3 lives at the end of each round with [img:Healthy Bananas] Healthy Bananas.

bottom.name: Monkey Wall Street
bottom.description: Hub of Monkey trades earns colossal income, generates lives each round, and collects income in radius. Wiki: In addition to the benefits of Central Market and the previous path 3 upgrades, this upgrade generates an additional $4,000 and 15 lives at the end of each round. This end-of-round cash gain is not affected by crosspathing, but it can be buffed with effects such as Monkey City and Geraldo's Fertilizer. Additionally, it automatically collects collectibles in its range such as bananas, Bloon traps, and Supply Drop crates. Its range is also increased from 40 to 75 units (~3.5x more range).
